events.name: Chicago White Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Sean Burke and two relievers combined on a four-hitter, Colson Montgomery hit his 24th home run and the Chicago White Sox beat the Toronto Blue Jays 3-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burke and 2 relievers combine on 4-hitter, Colson Montgomery homers as White Sox beat Blue Jays 3-0

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitched a four-hitter for his first regular-season complete game in 66 major league starts, and the Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the New York Yankees 8-2 in the opener of their day-night doubleheader Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamamoto fires 4-hitter and Ohtani leads offense as Dodgers top Yankees 8-2 in 1st game of twinbill

events.name: New York Mets at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Nolan McLean struck out 10 and allowed just two hits in six scoreless innings, Francisco Lindor homered and drove in three runs and the New York Mets won a series in Philadelphia for the first time in nearly four years, beating the Phillies 6-1 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: McLean strikes out 10, Lindor homers to lead Mets past Phillies 6-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Willson Contreras hit a two-run homer, Sonny Gray gave up one run and five hits over six innings, and the Boston Red Sox beat the Tampa Bay Rays 6-1 on Sunday for their 13th win in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat the Rays 6-1 behind Contreras and Gray for their 13th straight win

headlines.description: — Austin Riley and Drake Baldwin each hit two home runs and the Atlanta Braves beat the Texas Rangers 8-5 on Sunday to win the three-game series in a matchup of first-place teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baldwin has career-high 5 hits, including 2 homers, Riley adds 2 homers as Braves top Rangers 8-5

headlines.description: — Paul Skenes allowed one run and struck out eight in seven innings and the Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the Cleveland Guardians 7-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skenes strikes out 8 in 7 innings as Pirates roll to 7-1 win over Guardians

headlines.description: — Brandon Young allowed one run over seven innings, Coby Mayo homered, and the Baltimore Orioles extended their season-best winning streak to seven games by beating the Houston Astros 5-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Young shines over 7 innings as the Orioles stretch their win streak to 7 with a 5-2 win

headlines.description: — William Contreras hit a three-run homer in the bottom of the ninth off closer Pete Fairbanks to give the Milwaukee Brewers a 3-1 win over the Miami Marlins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Contreras' 3-run homer in the bottom of the 9th gives Brewers 3-1 win over Marlins

events.name: San Diego Padres at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Ty France hit a grand slam and a solo shot, Jackson Merrill also homered twice, and the San Diego Padres beat the Kansas City Royals 19-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ty France hits grand slam and solo HR, Jackson Merrill also hits 2 HRs as Padres beat Royals 19-2

headlines.description: — Shota Imanaga pitched seven shutout innings and Nico Hoerner had a bases-loaded triple and four RBI to lead the Chicago Cubs to a 10-1 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Imanaga throws 7 shutout innings and Cubs roll to 10-1 win over Twins

headlines.description: — Tyler Stephenson went deep twice, Hunter Greene struck out seven over six innings and the Cincinnati Reds weathered a three-homer afternoon from Hunter Goodman to beat
headlines.shortLinkText: Stephenson goes deep twice, Reds weather 3-homer game from Goodman in 9-6 win over Rockies

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams and Dylan Crews hit back-to-back homers in the fifth inning to send the Washington Nationals to a 5-2 victory over the Athletics on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Abrams and Crews hit back-to-back homers Nationals beat Athletics 5-2

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Ryan Johnson struck out five and allowed one run in five solid innings, Jorge Soler and Zach Neto delivered RBI hits and the Los Angeles Angels snapped a four-game skid with a 3-2 win over the Detroit Tigers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson, Soler and Neto power the Angels to a 3-2 win over the Tigers

headlines.description: — Logan Gilbert had 10 strikeouts across six strong innings, Luke Raley and Cole Young homered, and the Seattle Mariners beat the San Francisco Giants 6-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilbert has 10 strikeouts in 6 innings, Raley and Young hit HRs as Mariners beat Giants 6-3

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Max Kepler hit a walk-off RBI double in the 10th inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied from a seven-run deficit to beat the St. Louis Cardinals 8-7 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kepler hits walk-off double in 10th, Diamondbacks rally from 7-run deficit, beat Cardinals 8-7

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit a tiebreaking homer in the eighth inning and five Yankees pitchers combined on a four-hitter as New York edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 2-1 to split their day-night doubleheader Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jazz Chisholm Jr. hits tiebreaking homer in 8th and Yankees beat Dodgers 2-1 to split doubleheader
